transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we finalize this decision. Procurement's legal review just came back an hour ago with updated data-processing terms: EU customer audit events must be stored in the eu-west-1 region. Of the two shortlisted services, only StreamForge offers eu-west-1 residency under the current contract terms. NimbusMQ does not meet this requirement. I haven't attached these terms to the architecture review yet, but given the pipeline will process events from EU customers, this is a hard constraint that affects the NimbusMQ recommendation.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: This morning I confirmed while investigating a separate load-test harness issue that the production burst requirement for the audit-event pipeline is 40,000 events per second — the architecture document must specify required capacity at that level. NimbusMQ throttles at 25,000 events per second, while StreamForge supports 40,000. I haven't updated the architecture document yet because the harness investigation was a separate task, but this is a hard capacity constraint that also disqualifies NimbusMQ.
